messages:
alexa (Support): Hi @joe — sorry for the trouble. Can you paste one or two example request IDs / trace IDs from the failing calls? That’s the fastest way for SRE to locate spans. Also if you can include the curl you ran (with the token replaced) and a snippet of SDK logs that contains the request-id, that helps.

joe (Acme Inc.): Hi — here’s one id I see in our logs: trace id=abcd1234efgh at 2026-03-04T15:22:31Z. We call the API via the JS SDK; the response has `meta.request_id` as `req_01H8K2xyZ`. I can run curl and attach headers if that’s useful.

toni (CS): Thanks. Quick checklist we need from you:
- The exact failing request_id or trace_id (copy/paste)
- Approx timestamp (include timezone)
- A curl reproduction (redact tokens)
- SDK debug log lines +/- 30s around the timestamp
- If possible, a link to the Request details in the Console (Observability -> Requests)

mike (SRE): For curl reproduction, ask them to run this (redact token):
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"test"}' \
  -D headers.txt -o /dev/null
```
Then attach headers.txt — we look for `x-request-id` or `x-trace-id` in the response headers.

mike (SRE): If they use our Python or JS SDK the request id often shows up in `response.meta.request_id` or in the HTTP header `X-Request-ID`. Enabling verbose logs (DEBUG) will surface it. Example (Python):
```
import logging
logging.basicConfig(level=logging.DEBUG)
# run the request and capture stdout for the timestamp window
```

joe (Acme Inc.): OK I'll run curl and grab headers. Also where in the Console do I search for this?

alexa (Support): Console -> Observability -> Requests. Paste the `request_id` into the search box (top-left) and set the time range to +/- 2 minutes. If you don’t see it, note the exact timestamp and we can search by trace id from our side.

redwood-bot: support ticket RED-4921 created and linked to this thread :white_check_mark:

toni (CS): When attaching a debug bundle please include:
- headers.txt from the curl run
- SDK log snippet (5–10 lines) with timestamps
- the minimal payload you used to reproduce (JSON)
- your org-id/account-id (if available)

joe (Acme Inc.): Uploaded headers.txt and logs to the ticket, request_id=req_01H8K2xyZ. Timestamp 2026-03-04T15:22:31Z (UTC).

mike (SRE): Received — starting trace lookup now. Will update in ~30 mins. If we need deeper network capture we’ll request a short tcpdump/strace window but we avoid that unless necessary.

alexa (Support): Thanks everyone — marking as in-progress. SRE will post root cause and remediation steps here once triage is complete.
